questions.question: Who were the first to resettle in their towns after returning from exile?
options: Foreigners who were brought in from other distant lands
Only the kings and the members of their households
Only the soldiers who guarded the gates of the city
Israel, the priests, Levites, and temple servants
questions.answer: Israel, the priests, Levites, and temple servants

questions.question: Why were Judah and Jerusalem carried away to Babylon?
options: A flood that swept through Judah
A famine that emptied the cities
A great earthquake that struck the land
